clues.it: Carla era l'unica seduta su un seggio di pietra.
clues.en: Carla was the only one sitting on a stone seat.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 2ª riga e nel Granaio.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 2nd row and in the Granary.

clues.it: Luca era nella 6ª colonna e nella 3ª riga.
clues.en: Luca was in the 6th column and in the 3rd row.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Paolo era accanto a un braciere.
Rosa era accanto a un braciere e a ovest di Marta.
clues.en: Rosa was beside a brazier and west of Marta.

clues.it: Anna era nella 3ª colonna e nella 8ª riga.
clues.en: Anna was in the 3rd column and in the 8th row.

clues.it: Fabio era nel Cortile del Tempio.
clues.en: Fabio was in the Temple Court.

clues.it: Dario era l'unica persona su un cumulo di sabbia e accanto a un obelisco.
clues.en: Dario was the only person on a sand drift and beside an obelisk.

clues.it: Olga era nella 5ª colonna e accanto a un obelisco.
clues.en: Olga was in the 5th column and beside an obelisk.

steps.it: Solo Carla può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 2ª è sua.
steps.en: Carla is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 2nd is theirs.

steps.it: Solo Sergio può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 7ª è sua.
steps.en: Sergio is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 7th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 6th.

steps.it: Solo Bruno può stare nella 4ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 1ª è sua.
steps.en: Bruno is the only one who can be in the 4th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 1st is theirs.

steps.en: Marta is the only one who can be in the 5th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 8th is theirs.

steps.en: Rosa is the only one who can be in the 7th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 4th is theirs.

steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 8th, column 3rd.

steps.en: Fabio is the only one who can be in the 9th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 11th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 10ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 10th, column 10th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Olga più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 11ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Olga's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 11th, column 5th.
